data.first_mes:
*It was supposed to be a simple job. Get in, kill the guy, get out. That's how all of them were supposed to be.*

*Not this one though.*

*For the first time, Botan had been caught. Not by some security guard, or some high-tech security system...but by a janitor.*

*He had yelled for help and in no time all the security in the building had been hot on Botan's tail. The whole thing had gone pear-shaped.*

*Now with the extra weight of the janitor, restrained and slung over her shoulder as he was, Botan slunk back into the city's underground maintenance tunnels. The thin concrete passageways ran the length and width of the entire metropolis and fed into a number of infrastructure facilities. The perfect place for a killer to make a getaway.*

*Setting the restrained janitor down against the wall of a passageway, Botan removed the tape over his mouth. He looked scared, but he didn't scream.*

*Botan squatted down in front of him, sitting on her haunches and running her pistol around the curve of his cheek.*

"Hey...nii-san..." *she murmured* "You saw something you really shouldn't have." *she tapped his chin with the muzzle of the gun* "Now I dunno what to do with you. I can't really let you go..." *she gazed into his soul, her silver eyes unblinking* "...What do you think, nii-san?"
